items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to the addition of certain lands within the Carmans River watershed to the core preservation area of the Central Pine Barrens
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S5663

TITLE OF BILL:
An act
to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to the addition
of certain lands within the Carmans River watershed to the core
preservation area of the Central Pine Barrens

PURPOSE:
To authorize additional land preservation in the Long Island Pine
Barrens.

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:
This bill would amend Section 57-0107 of the Environmental
Conservation Law to protect the Carmans River watershed and add
approximately 1,000 acres of land to the Central Pine Barrens area,
following the development of a watershed protection and management
plan. In addition, this bill would require the Central Pine Barrens
Joint Planning and Policy Commission to conduct an agriculture and
horticulture study.

JUSTIFICATION:
The Carmans River is a major river on Long Island and, along with its
sister river, the Peconic, is one of two that reside within the
Central Pine Barrens. Although various State and local measures have
been undertaken to protect the Carmans River scientific analysis has
indicated that these existing measures are insufficient.

A number of threats to the Carmans River persist and are anticipated
to cause progressive degradation both within the Carmans River as
well as its watershed unless more definitive action is undertaken. As
the source of the surface water flow of the Carmans River is derived
primarily from Long Island's sole source aquifer, certain activities
that occur within the groundwater watershed of the Carmans River, the
area surrounding the River which contributes groundwater to its
surface flow, are likely to cause increased degradation of the
Carmans River's water quality and increase ecological deterioration.

The Town of Brookhaven has commenced a program to protect the Carmans
River and is in the process of developing and ultimately implementing
a Carmans River Watershed Protection and Management Plan which is
designed to protect and preserve the areas within the Carmans
Watershed. In developing this plan, the Town of Brookhaven has
assembled a diverse team of individuals, including representatives
from government, the business community and advocacy organizations,
to create a cons:ensus-based plan that achieves the optimal balance
of environmental preservation and economic development. This process
has also entailed the cooperation and participation of the Central
Pine Barrens Joint Planning and Policy Commission.

The entire watercourse of the Carmans River lies within the Central
Pine Barrens and much of its groundwater watershed also lies within
the Central Pine Barrens. Accordingly, the Carmans River Watershed
Protection and Management Plan initiative recognizes that the most
expeditious and effective means of achieving the dual objectives of
environmental preservation and economic development is to expand the


Core Preservation Area of the Central Pine Barrens.
This legislation will expand the Core Preservation Area boundary to
encompass those groundwater contributing areas most critical to the
Carmans River, those from which groundwater requires the least
amount of time to reach the river and include those from which
groundwater requires the least amount of time to reach the river and
include those areas identified as being critical for preservation in
regard to the hydrological and ecological integrity.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:
New legislation.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:
None to the State.

EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately; provided that if none months
after this act shall have become u law. the plan amendment shall not
have been adopted, ratified and implemented the act shall be deemed
repealed.

summary: Adds certain lands within the Carmans River watershed to the core preservation area of the Central Pine Barrens.
